ff-shooting-positions-a-2.back: Bone. Stack the elbows under the rifle, then relax.
ff-shooting-positions-a-2.diagram:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 300" font-family="sans-serif" role="img" aria-label="Comparison. Bone support: the elbow sits right under the rifle, stacked on a knee or the ground, so you can relax and stay steady. Muscle support: the elbow sticks out and the arm holds the weight, so it tires and wobbles. Stack the bones, then relax.">
<rect x="0" y="0" width="400" height="300" fill="#fffaf0"/>
<text x="200" y="26" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">Bone holds still. </svg>

ff-shooting-positions-a-3.back: Where the barrel points when your muscles are relaxed and you are supported.
